source: &376 There's nothing like being in Trance.
target: &376 没什么能比得上置身迷境。

source: &377 A world built of abstracts and intellect.
target: &377 那是一个由抽象概念与智慧构筑的世界。

source: &378 Of tangible thought, where every part has been crafted by an individual soul.
target: &378 思想在那里有了形体，每一处都出自一个独特灵魂的创造。

source: &379 It's the purest form of contact a person can have, mind to mind. It's the pinnacle of human achievement.
target: &379 意识与意识直接相连，这是人与人最纯粹的接触，也是人类文明的巅峰。

source: &380 Some might say that achievement in the physical world is somehow more meaningful.
target: &380 有人也许会说，现实世界里的成就才更有意义。

source: &381 To them, I say - 'join the future, or be surpassed by it'.
target: &381 我的回答是：“拥抱未来，否则就等着被未来甩在身后。”

source: &382 I don't see why anyone would choose the outside voluntarily.
target: &382 我真不明白，为什么有人会主动选择外面的世界。

source: &383 A world defined by barriers - whether material, or personal.
target: &383 那里到处都是隔阂——物质的，或是人与人之间的。

source: &384 Within the Trance, we are millions of minds, as one.
target: &384 在迷境里，我们数百万个意识融为一体。

source: &385 But even as far as we've come, there's still one serious flaw:
target: &385 不过，发展到今天，它还是有个很严重的缺陷：

source: &386 Its reliance on the 'real world' as its backbone.
target: &386 它仍然得靠“现实世界”来支撑。

source: &589 ...and disconnections. Damn.
target: &589 ……还会断线。该死。

source: &590 Don't panic. I'll just go and speak to the building manager.

source: &591 It's not like there's anything to be afraid of out there...
target: &591 外面又没什么好怕的……

source: &592 Let's get this over with.
target: &592 赶紧把这事解决吧。
